newsitem.title: USA: Distraught New York father kills children, self.
newsitem.headline: Distraught New York father kills children, self.

text.p: A man apparently distraught over his wife's request for a divorce killed his two children and himself, police said on Thursday.
The bodies of the 10-year-old boy and his 8-year-old sister were found in a bed in the family's New York City apartment, police said.
Their father, Mouammed Talaforoush, 50, was found hanging by a nylon cord, police said. Around his neck was a greeting card with a heart that read "I Love You," police said.
Flowers had been placed on top of the children's bodies, and the little girl was clutching a doll, police said.
Police were not certain if they were suffocated or poisoned, and there were no visible injuries.
Talaforoush, an Iranian immigrant who had been in this country for 10 years, was believed to be upset after his wife Sharin, who is stationed in the U.S. Army in South Korea, asked for a divorce.
More than 15 notes, many written in Persian, were in various places around the family's apartment, police said.
The father called a psychiatrist on Thursday morning and said he had killed his two children, police said.
The psychiatrist called police but did not have the man's correct address. Police then drove the psychiatrist around the city's Brooklyn borough until he found the family's apartment.
Police broke down the apartment door and found the three bodies inside. The little boy was named Toufan and his sister's name was Amy, police said.
